metadata.ablation: freeze first live plan; no further model calls

plan.reason: 5-D with only 24 of 100 evaluations used and complete stagnation (no recent improvement), so the surrogate must be sampled more broadly rather than exploited. Auto surrogate lets held-out RMSE choose between RBF and quadratic as data accumulate; current_to_best balances guided convergence with diversity. Slightly higher exploration (0.35) and radius (0.15) counter stagnation by rewarding novel regions, while a moderate population of 30 and 5 generations keeps surrogate cost manageable within the fixed true-evaluation budget. Crossover 0.8 and mutation 0.6 are standard robust settings.
